decision.headline: REDUCE: a full exit costs more than it saves, but the carry ($5,697) does not cover the expected loss ($7,080); in the worst 1% of outcomes it loses $518,872 on average (100% of equity); a 5.2% oracle drop liquidates it, less than the 12.2% stress.
reasons: Over 30 days: expected loss $7,080 vs carry $5,697 (net $-1,383); leaving now costs $78,946 (1.99% price impact + fees, Pendle swap quote).
Driver: sUSDe issuer (Ethena): depeg: $3,760 of expected loss (1.05% chance over the horizon, $359,761 if it happens, liquidates 76% of the time).
Driver: Oracle misprice / misconfiguration: $1,514 of expected loss (0.45% chance over the horizon, $334,829 if it happens, liquidates 74% of the time).
A 5.16% fall in the oracle price liquidates the position (HF 1.053); the stress it should survive is 12.2% (underlying's worst 1-year drawdown 2.25%).
The oracle is treated as following the PT market (not confirmed: see the oracle sensitivity line), so a temporary depeg turns into a realised loss through liquidation.
De-lever: sell $1,293,969 of PT (33%) and repay debt → HF 1.140, liquidation at −12.2%; costs $1,023; expected loss $7,080 → $4,609, CVaR99 $518,872 → $435,116, carry $5,697 → $4,350.
A full exit would only pay if incident probabilities were 12.0× the estimates.
Oracle sensitivity (inference ambiguous): if the oracle were fundamental, expected loss $4,179 (vs $7,080), P(liquidation) 0.46% (vs 1.25%), verdict REDUCE — the same.
